edition.en: Standard Ebooks edition of Edward Thomas’s poetry
edition.zh: 据 Standard Ebooks 爱德华·托马斯诗集

basis.en: First published in 1917; the author died in 1917.
basis.zh: 1917 年首次发表；作者卒于 1917 年。

note.en: Edward Thomas remembered an express train stopping, unscheduled, at a small Cotswold station on a hot afternoon in June 1914; the poem was printed in 1917, after his death. It records almost nothing: a name, some willows, a blackbird. That is why it has lasted, one minute kept whole.
note.zh: 爱德华·托马斯记得 1914 年 6 月一个炎热的下午，一列快车在科茨沃尔德的一个小站意外停下；这首诗在他去世后的 1917 年付印。诗几乎什么也没记录：一个站名，几棵柳树，一只乌鸫。正因如此它才流传下来——一分钟，被完整地保存。

excerpt.orig:
And for that minute a blackbird sang
Close by,
excerpt.en:
And for that minute a blackbird sang
Close by,
excerpt.zh:
就在那一分钟，一只乌鸫在
近旁歌唱，

note.en: One unscheduled minute at a country station, kept whole by a list of names, willows and a blackbird; its smallness is the achievement, and it is nearly flawless.
note.zh: 乡间小站一分钟的意外停靠，靠地名、柳树和一只乌鸫完整保存；小，正是它的成就，几乎无瑕。
